Files never leave this device

Reorder, delete and rotate PDF pages

See every page at once, drag pages into a new order, remove the ones you do not need and add pages from other PDFs. Then download the new document.

How to organize PDF pages

  1. Choose a PDF. Add more files if you want to combine pages.
  2. Drag pages to reorder them, or use the page buttons to rotate or delete.
  3. Select Download to save the organized PDF.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
Can I reorder pages without a mouse?
Yes. Each page has move earlier and move later buttons, which also work with a keyboard or a touch screen.
How do I delete pages from a PDF?
Select the delete button on each page you want to remove, then download. The deleted pages are not included in the new file.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
